result.stderr:
USAGE:
    calver.dll [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    calver.dll 
    calver.dll --format YY.0M0D.PATCH
    calver.dll --format YYYY.0M -p rc
    calver.dll -b

OPTIONS:
                             DEFAULT                                            
    -h, --help                                Prints help information           
        --format <FORMAT>    YYYY.MM.PATCH    CalVer format using tokens: YYYY, 
                                              YY, 0Y, MM, 0M, WW, 0W, DD, 0D,   
                                              PATCH                             
    -f, --folder <PATH>                       Repository-relative folder whose  
                                              commits determine the version     
    -p, --prerelease <ID>                     Prerelease identifier (e.g.,      
                                              alpha, beta, rc)                  
    -b, --buildmetadata                       Include build metadata (short SHA)
                                              in the version                    
    -o, --output <FORMAT>    Text             Output format: text or json
